title: Tender Can't Be Cancelled Citing Expiry Of Bid Validity After Invoking Extension Clause: Patna High Court
description: The Patna High Court has held that once a tendering authority invokes the contractual mechanism for extension of bid validity and obtains the bidders' consent, it cannot subsequently justify cancellation of the tender solely on the ground that the original bid validity period expired. The Court held that such a course is inconsistent with the scheme of the Standard Bidding Document (SBD). A Division Bench of Acting Chief Justice Sudhir Singh and Justice Ranjan Kumar Jha quashed the cancellation
